messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the prospect of 30,000 units per year; please provide the data to verify this volume so we can fully account for it in our calculation. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

To answer your question, adding any further fasteners or C-parts to this bundle would increase our efficiency and allow us to offer more attractive overall terms. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In response to your movement, we propose a revised price of €5.43 per unit for the 24-month agreement with 30 days net payment. This offer remains valid for 30 days.
